duplicate_check: Existing common prompt already requires signed scope arithmetic and closure; consumer notes already distinguish POCI gains. Refine wording, avoid duplicate checklists.

rules.title: Interpret disclosed cumulative-gain movements
rules.mandate: When issuer presents POCI adjustment as cumulative gain added to book, a decrease is impairment loss; separate acquired gains and historical losses.
rules.evidence: Signed source row, opening/closing balances and basis
rules.exceptions: Ordinary loss reserves/FVTPL require their own basis
rules.double_counting_risk: Do not treat a balance movement and P&L line as independent charges
rules.implementation: Refine existing consumer-lending note, not new SQLite rule

rules.title: Disjoint column scopes
rules.mandate: Before adding rows/columns, check whether subtotal already includes another component. If hierarchy uncertain, show alternatives and leave scope unresolved.
rules.evidence: Headers, component/subtotal values, period and units
rules.exceptions: Clearly independent components may be summed
rules.double_counting_risk: Subsidiary/operation totals plus their feedstock twice
rules.pass_example: 92643+2654+98636+1081+1513=196527 using reported subtotal with component caveat
rules.implementation: One clause in existing common sign/scope instruction

rules.title: Closure conditions stay attached
rules.mandate: If any essential closure evidence is pending or deferred to new question, retain partial and describe what remains.
rules.evidence: Incoming closure condition plus current evidence
rules.exceptions: Explicit confirmed-not-disclosed closure alternative may satisfy a condition if established within searched scope
rules.double_counting_risk: Avoid cloning unanswered scope as substitute for original question
rules.implementation: Clarify existing ledger contract; no new semantic engine
